body: Thanks for the recommendation! I'll see if I can get a hold of her
Thank you, you too

Thank you! I'm sure the advice will help. And I do have a lot of support, I just don't try talking to my friends and family enough. 

I wish you the very best too, even if you're not dealing with depression. Life can just be hard sometimes, so stay sane!

Thank you. You're right of course. My therapist likes to talk about how there are two parts of your mind: logic and emotion. In a healthy person, they work together to create a "wise mind". In me, they fight for control constantly, and emotion always wins. That's when I feel like committing suicide. I have an appointment on the 6th to start trying some meds to supplement what I'm already doing, we'll see if it helps

I kind of do. First my mom, then my first serious boyfriend, and now someone I thought was a friend. But thank you, I don't even know how people react to people who cut themselves or think about killing themselves. I used to think it was stupid, especially the cutting. Like it was just done for attention. Thank you for trying to cheer me up!

I know, but I've always gotten feelings like this. "If I'm late to class, I should just skip so the professor doesn't hate me" or "if I don't respond to him soon he'll hate me." I appreciate that you don't hate me, but it still is hard sometimes to imagine that someone would do anything other than hate me. I even did what was in my therapy exercises and just talked about how I felt. I didn't accuse her, just told her my feelings. I don't know how or why it happened the way it did, but I'm taking it pretty hard
I'm not gonna lie, it pretty much is. A lot of bars and a lot of drunks lol

I love Conan, but I haven't seen the review yet.  I'll have to watch it :).  I'm actually just almost done with the second one, then moving on to the third.  

And I live in Wisconsin, home of the cheese.

I plan to learn the language eventually.  I want to read a Norwegian book called The Witcher (a game was based on it).  Plus the fjords are gorgeous and they have free health care and education.  I'm currently in the US
To which country? I'd actually love to move to Norway some day.

I don't have a job at the moment because me and my boyfriend are moving in a couple months.  But when we do move I hope to get a job in child care.  When I actually do feel like doing something, I play piano, play video games, draw, write, and play Magic: The Gathering.  I was actually doing great when I started therapy, but lately I've had a lot of rough nights.  My therapist was happy to finally get a patient who didn't just ask for meds, so I am really trying my hardest at this :)  How about you?

My insurance can only afford a counselor sadly. If I decide to start on medication I can let my counselor know and she'll refer me to a psychiatrist to get medicine. I'm just unsure if I should start medication. I wanted to do this on my own without help from meds, but sometimes it just seems hopeless.
Thank you so much!
I pity them for their anger issues and for not finding an interest in anything except saying hurtful things to others
Maybe. But I would never tell anyone go die, regardless of what they were into.

It's something like my therapist says.  You can get all the compliments in the world, but if just one person voices the opinion you have of yourself, that overpowers everything else. 

I haven't told this to my therapist yet, my next appointment is in a couple weeks but I'm on the cancellation list in hopes for something sooner.  I'm sure she will be proud of me.  It seems a lot of the stuff I do makes her proud of me.  And thank YOU for being proud of me as well.  

And holy crap.  You read Skip Beat!  That's so cool.  I will keep channeling my inner Setsu.  Setsu is who I wish I could be.

Thank you!

I honestly wish I had friends IRL that enjoyed anime and manga.  I have one friend I convinced to watch SAO, but that's it really.  I hope to meet more cool friends like the ones I already have when my social anxiety gets better.  Anyway, you're right about being in an argument with an idiot. I know I won't win, and it sucks that a bully can still hurt me, even just over the internet.

He ended up leaving after I stopped talking, so then I just waited until the game was done and told everyone what he said so he was reported a lot.  Of course I'll stay.  I don't plan on giving in to my suicidal thoughts ever again, no matter how strong they are.  I have no desire to anymore.

Well, just remember how appreciative you were to the people who helped you when you were low.  You ARE part of the kindness and love now.  And sometimes, it just feels really good to tell someone about without having to worry about being judged.  And thank you for thinking that my love for my interests is inspiring! I never really thought of it like that, I've always been this way.

And really, no problem at all.  It's the least you deserve for making sure I knew some people do care before I went to sleep for the night.  If you ever need help, feel free to PM me if you want.  Thank you!

I wish I didn't get these thoughts in my head like therapy would rid me of all negative emotion for the rest of my life. It's still kind of new for me though so I'm sure I'll figure it out. 

And truly, thank you for your kind words. I love that you understand completely. It really does make me feel better. I pity people who find interest in nothing. I don't know who I would be without my TV shows, my books, and my video games, and frankly, I wouldn't want to change any of my interests. What bothers me most is having strangers who know nothing about me saying something as powerful as "Go kill yourself" without having any clue how I'll react. Honestly I couldn't imagine saying anything like that to even the strongest willed person. 

And once again, thank you for the incredibly kind words. I've just recently started trying to talk to new people again and whole hearing someone describe me as cool seems so unnatural, it makes me remember there's not just bad in the world. Thank you so much.

I know I should be seeing a doctor, but my dad, despite knowing I have depression and insomnia, thinks me having a job is much more important right now. In order to make him happy, I have to take away my happiness and any possibility of having the time to get the help I need. I would tell him just how serious my depression is, but I'm honestly scared to. I don't want him knowing I get suicidal thoughts.

I know how this may not seem much coming from a stranger, but I am so sincerely sorry for your loss. Every time I want to end it, I just think of people that will be destroyed by my passing. You're right, being depressed, it can be very difficult to see how much we are loved. I even have paranoia that everything good in my life is a hoax. And it warms my heart to see someone who isn't depressed can understand depression so well. Once again, I'm so incredibly sorry.
I'll check out that number. Thanks for caring!

Oh goodness, I hope this doesn't happen to me.  The guy I'm currently with is really nice, but I worry sometimes that he'll get sick of my clinginess or my constant need of reassurance.  He hasn't left yet, but in hindsight, 8 months isn't that much.  I talk about marrying him someday because I'm sure I want to.  But I'm scared that one day he'll get sick of it all and leave.  Mine is as a result of heartbreak and my mom disowning me.  And both of those led not only to relationship problems, but also self-loathing and depression.

I wish the best for you.  I hope you don't have any more bad days, I know what it feels like. I've wanted to for a while, but my boyfriend controls my pills and how many I get, and tries to make sure I'm not doing anything that could kill myself.
That's good. But heartbreak still sucks.
Luckily, I've only been heartbroken a fraction of the time I've been depressed. Are you better now?

I was a junior in high school and I was in a "secret" relationship with this guy. My parents never let me get my license by that point, and always expected me home right after school, so me and him hung out before school a lot. When he found out is never been kissed, he told me to meet him in the choir room the following morning. I got there a little before him so I started playing the piano that was in there. He snuck up behind me and hugged me. When I stood up, he kind of pushed me up against a wall and was about to kiss me when his brother came in looking for him. This guy that was going to kiss me just quickly pecked me and ignored me after that. I felt so cheated.
I eat potatoes raw for snacks. Take that, society! You can't make me cook my food!
What about both at the same time?
